name: Wang CFG schedules
plain: A family of cfg shapes over progress: linear, cosine, inverse linear, sine, V, Λ, and a power-cosine. Docstring notes paper ambiguity on whether it multiplies w or w−1.
math:
τ=progress, ω(τ;b̄):
linear 2b̄τ; cosine b̄(1−cos πτ); invlinear 2b̄(1−τ); sine b̄(1+cos πτ); V 2b̄|1−2τ|; Λ 2b̄(1−|1−2τ|); pcs b̄(1−cos πτ^κ)/2
A: w=1+ω(τ;w̄−1); B: w=ω(τ;w̄)
